name: remember
title: Work remembered as a procedure, run with no agent
note: An agent does a task: it calls echo twice in one emission, then once more. The work is remembered: the apprentice reads the trace, compiles it, and adds the contract to itself with no approval. Called on new input, the procedure runs with no agent in its frame. From a narrowed Boundary without echo it faults at intake; the same contract is not remembered twice; input outside its refinement goes back to the agent. The agent is scripted, not a model, and says so.
